```python
import pandas as pd

# Reconstruct the table from the DataFrame context
data = {
    "Description Losses": ["Direct War Losses", "Murdered", "Deaths In Prisons & Camps",
                           "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps", "Murdered in Eastern Regions",
                           "Deaths other countries", "Total"],
    "1939/40": [360000, 75000, 69000, None, None, None, 504000],
    "1940/41": [None, 100000, 210000, 42000, None, None, 352000],
    "1941/42": [None, 116000, 220000, 71000, None, None, 407000],
    "1942/43": [None, 133000, 266000, 142000, None, None, 541000],
    "1943/44": [None, 82000, 381000, 218000, None, None, 681000],
    "1944/45": [183000, None, None, None, 100000, None, 270000],
    "Total": [543000, 506000, 1146000, 473000, 100000, 2000, 2770000],
}
tbl = pd.DataFrame(data)

total_row = tbl[tbl["Description Losses"] == "Total"].iloc[0]
years = [c for c in tbl.columns if c != "Description Losses"]
answer = [y for y in years if total_row[y] < 350000]
print(answer)
```

The only year with total losses below 350,000 is **1944/45** (270,000 losses). Note: 1940/41 shows 352,000, which is above 350,000.
